24inline std::string normalize_path(std::string path)
25{
26 static const std::string device_prefix("Device.");
27 if (path.rfind(device_prefix, 0) == 0) {
28 path.erase(0, device_prefix.length());
29 }
30 return path;
31}

33template <typename T>
34bool read_param_via_common_socket(const std::string &object_path, const std::string &name, T &value)
35{
36 auto *client = BplConfigService::instance().common_client();
37 LOG_IF(!client, ERROR) << "BPL common Ambiorix client is not initialized";
38 return client && client->get_param(value, normalize_path(object_path), name);
39}

41inline wbapi::AmbiorixVariantSmartPtr get_object_via_common_socket(const std::string &object_path)
42{
43 auto *client = BplConfigService::instance().common_client();
44 LOG_IF(!client, ERROR) << "BPL common Ambiorix client is not initialized";
45 return client ? client->get_object(normalize_path(object_path))
46 : wbapi::AmbiorixVariantSmartPtr{};

59inline bool resolve_path_via_common_socket(const std::string &search_path,
60 std::string &absolute_path,
61 const char *caller = __builtin_FUNCTION())
62{
63 auto *client = BplConfigService::instance().common_client();
64 if (!client) {
65 LOG(ERROR) << caller << ": BPL common Ambiorix client is not initialized";
66 return false;
67 }
68
69 const auto normalized_path = normalize_path(search_path);
70 const auto success = client->resolve_path(normalized_path, absolute_path);
71 LOG_IF(!success, ERROR) << caller << ": failed to resolve path " << normalized_path
72 << " via BPL common Ambiorix client";
73 return success;
74}
